emit_piece.piece:
Hello Hannah,

Thank you for writing to us about order 94795. I am sorry that the blender jug leaks at the base. I am on it.

I tested your blender in our lab last week and it failed at 3,400 rpm. That result shows the seal is at fault.

I have sent a replacement jug by tracked post. No charge, of course. The courier will text you a time slot.

Best wishes,
Marta
